---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A one or two sentence description of the feature.

## Problem it solves

What are you trying to do that the current app doesn't support well?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you imagine this working. Screenshots, mockups, or examples from other apps are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about?

## Additional context

Callsign, operating region, typical band conditions, or anything else that gives useful context.
